questions.prompt: What is the primary function of contrast in typography?

options.text: To establish the brand's primary color palette.
To create a sharp visual boundary between a letter and the background.
To ensure the font size automatically scales on mobile devices.
To reduce the file size of the loaded web fonts.

questions.explanation: Contrast defines the boundary of a shape, allowing the eye to resolve it clearly without straining.
questions.hint: Consider how shapes are separated from what sits behind them.
questions.testedLearningPoint: Understand how contrast impacts readability for aging eyes and low vision.

questions.prompt: What is the target contrast ratio required for normal body text?
questions.explanation: Standard body text requires a ratio of 4.5 to ensure readability for users with moderate vision loss.
questions.hint: It is the standard threshold that sits between 3 and 7.
questions.testedLearningPoint: Identify the 4.5 threshold for standard text readability.

questions.prompt: According to the 2026 WebAIM Million report, approximately how many homepages currently contain low contrast text?
questions.explanation: An analysis found that 83.9 percent of the top one million homepages contained low contrast text.
questions.hint: Low contrast represents the most common failure on the internet today.
questions.testedLearningPoint: Recognize the prevalence of low contrast issues across modern digital design.
